The Jan 20 candidate has conflicting crowd reports, including conflicting NHRC 15:00 estimates; ICNL-IRIM also reports peak 5,000, AFP about 5,000, bne more than 10,000, while CNA’s opened body calls the protest small without a count. Searches did not establish another dated Jan 1–19, regional or separate sectoral gathering; this is not evidence of absence. Open-web coverage is non-exhaustive and not equivalent to LexisNexis.
